answer: Delayed Beacon Assignment.** Each epoch, a public randomness beacon (e.g., drand) outputs a seed only after identities must commit an encrypted agent ID. The seed then assigns each ID to a random harbor shard and a task slot, revealed post-commitment; attackers cannot precompute which shards their fakes will occupy.
